indexes.purpose: Find reviewer and worker queues.
Find claimable expired worker leases.
Resolve immutable generation receipt across fenced retries.
Find completed export artifacts approaching collection expiry.

invariants: Import requires an artifact and export requires an immutable selection.
Only the active fence can checkpoint or alter the plan.
A changed plan digest invalidates all previous approvals.
Every import after inspection pins source container, source profile and immutable inspection manifest. A staged import pins selected roots, dependency artifact digests and plan revision.
Import dry run does not create owner-visible drafts, active crosswalks, generation commitments or learner effects.

A generation can commit once. Require all exact owner receipts and active approvals, then publish private editor visibility or an explicitly authorized activation barrier with crosswalk receipts. No partial root is visible.
Export uses a direction-enabled exact format, edition and profile revision. The selection is immutable. Required losses and missing disclosure or rights approvals block result availability.

An applied export has one protected output, validation receipt and collection expiry. Retrying completion returns the same result. A generated or expired output cannot be redownloaded solely by knowing its UUID.
The current plan manifest pins its exact graph or export reports and predecessor manifest. A replaced private generation remains closed and cannot be resumed under a successor plan.
Every selected root names its exact same-plan TransferRecord, so dependent reachability is reproducible for each selected root.
entities.retention: Retain job, decision history and published owner receipts for seven years by default. Expire failed private staging after 30 days unless held.

scenarios.title: Multipart finalization rejects gaps and verifies exact content
given: Private upload declares 9 bytes. Parts are present at offsets 0 and 6, three bytes each.
when: Finalize with offsets 0 and 6.
then: Return UPLOAD_PARTS_MISSING. No artifact becomes available and no finalization event exists.

scenarios.title: Repeated source key and local edits keep original identity
given: Approved crosswalk maps source scope term-a and item n1 to target A. Latest target revision was edited locally.
when: Plan reimport with the same source fingerprint.
then: Suppress new version and preserve target A and local edits. Report informational divergence.

scenarios.title: Changed source and target require explicit three-way decision
given: An imported formula changed both at the source and in the native draft.
when: Reimport updated XML into the same mapping namespace.
then: Set merge pending. Keep both baselines and prevent approval until assessment reviewer verifies parity.

scenarios.title: Unknown executable problem stays blocked
given: OLX problem includes a script that calls an external dependency. No equivalent verified grader is registered.
when: Attempt to accept the difference as a warning and apply plan.
then: Reject BLOCKING_LOSS_CANNOT_BE_ACCEPTED. Learner publication remains unchanged.

scenarios.title: Release barrier keeps partially promoted owner graph private
given: Curriculum owner staged its rows. Assessment owner's readiness receipt times out.
when: Retry with the same plan and idempotency key after the owner returns.
then: First request exposes no staging. Retry activates exactly one generation and writes one mapping receipt.

scenarios.title: Late destination revision forces renewed review
given: Approved plan pinned native draft revision 7. Another editor publishes revision 8.
when: Apply the old approved plan.
then: Reject TARGET_REVISION_CHANGED and return to awaiting review. Preserve both draft revisions.

scenarios.title: Legacy library snapshot preserves draws and unresolved provenance
given: An OLX course contains six local problem IDs and a legacy reusable library key whose separate archive uses different IDs.
when: Stage the course and library in one plan.
then: Preserve the six-item course-local pool and draw count two. Hold uncertain crosswalks for review.

scenarios.title: A signed archive still fails unsafe path validation
given: An archive passes configured signature verification and contains an encoded traversal entry.
when: Run quarantine inspection.
then: Reject PACKAGE_PATH_REJECTED before expansion. Signature does not authorize bypass.

scenarios.title: Two activity occurrences share a resource but not state
given: One resource is referenced by manifest items intro and review.
when: Commit a bookmark in intro and launch review.
then: Review starts with its own state and cannot read intro bookmark.
When the sequencer creates a new attempt at intro, it starts from edition defaults. Its earlier bookmark remains attached only to the historic intro attempt.

scenarios.title: Replay returns a durable receipt without double time
given: First runtime request reached the server and receipt was lost.
when: Replay exact request and idempotency key, then finalize with 126,000 milliseconds.
then: The replay returns state revision 8 and one receipt. The registration accrues 126,000 milliseconds once.

scenarios.title: Old tab cannot update after takeover
given: Browser A owns epoch 3. Browser B takes over and receives epoch 4.
when: Browser A attempts a later score commit.
then: Reject LAUNCH_EPOCH_STALE. Preserve browser B and existing accepted evidence.

scenarios.title: Invalid mutation makes a runtime batch atomic failure
given: A 2004 session can write cmi.location but not cmi.learner_id.
when: Send both writes in one batch.
then: Return RUNTIME_ELEMENT_REJECTED with first rejected sequence. Neither element changes.

scenarios.title: Fourth-edition shared data grant refuses cross-occurrence write
given: Manifest grants occurrence B read access to shared store memory and occurrence A write access.
when: Submit an edition-valid write under B.
then: Reject write and preserve current value even though the field name and edition are supported.
A new credit attempt on the same tree with default retention can read prior committed store data. An explicit attempt-lifetime store starts unset.

scenarios.title: Sequencing branch retains frozen child order after resume
given: A selection cluster froze child order C then A for attempt 1 and suspended at C.
when: Resume then request Continue.
then: Deliver A without drawing B or reseeding.

scenarios.title: Objective unknown is distinct from failed
given: Shared objective normalized measure is unknown before the mapped SCO reports an outcome.
when: Evaluate a rule requiring known measure less than threshold.
then: Do not treat unknown as numeric zero. Evaluate using edition knownness semantics.

scenarios.title: Valid QTI subset requires answer and score parity
given: A multi-select QTI fixture scores exact A+C as 2 and A alone as 1. Native candidate would score A alone as zero.
when: Run transfer parity vectors.
then: Mark the difference as blocking until exact partial-credit behavior is verified.

scenarios.title: Wrong LTI audience cannot establish a native launch

given: A synthetic published course is eligible for a tested fourth-edition generator. Its portable projection intentionally excludes one optional private editorial note.

given: The target edition is disabled on one profile. A second approved profile could render a required assessment only by embedding confidential solutions.
